newsitem.title: INDIA: Twenty feared killed in India truck accident.
newsitem.headline: Twenty feared killed in India truck accident.

text.p: At least 20 people were believed to have died when the truck they were travelling in plunged off a bridge into a crocodile-infested river in western India, local authorities said on Sunday.

P.S. Mehra, an official of the Rajasthan state government, said the small truck carrying two dozen passengers collided with another vehicle on a bridge near Dhaulpur town, 240 km (150 miles) southwest of New Delhi.
The truck fell 45 metres (150 feet) into the river, which is a breeding ground for crocodiles and large tortoises.
Mehra said two passengers swam to safety and three bodies had been recovered.
